description:
[Merchant] Every airing of the merchant's placements between from and to, across all products, ordered by start time and each in its rule's time zone. Answers "what is on air this week" in one call. The range may span at most 400 days.

**Endpoint:** GET /placements/calendar

from.description: Start of the range: a date (YYYY-MM-DD, the start of that day in UTC) or an ISO-8601 instant with an offset, e.g. 2026-10-19T00:00:00+03:00

to.description: End of the range, after from, in the same forms

useSandbox.description: Use the sandbox (the default) rather than production

name: payware_products_get_airing_calendar
